messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. The corridor has two long walls, the north wall and the south wall. You are 0.9 m from the north wall. Is the north wall on your left or on your right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Left
Person 2 is facing you, so their left and right are reversed relative to yours; since you are 0.9 m from the north wall and they are in the middle, your greater distance from the north wall means it is on your left.
